Hi Laneia, we’re sorry to see the 1-star rating. Since no details were provided, we’re not sure what happened or what led to your experience. We would appreciate the opportunity to better understand your concerns. Please feel free to contact our office directly so we can look into this further.

This is a predatory clinic. I lived in Los Angeles near them in 2020-2021, they were just around the corner, so it was convenient. My baby Akita puppy caught Parvo and they wanted nothing to do with us, just showed us the door. Whatever the operating procedure, there was zero empathy. I moved out of CA shortly after.

Starting early 2025 they began sending me invoices, $500, $600 for services never rendered. I called them, they said they switched the billing software and that new software caught some irregularities. The thing is, they don't take you on credit. Each time I visited, I paid on the spot, and yet the bills keep on coming.

Guys, if you don't stop, I'll make it my 2026 resolution to burn you on every review site. Go away or get sued.

PS - My Akita is fine, 6 years later, after a $6K stay at an emergency clinic for 5 days. Welcome to California, folks.

Very friendly, welcoming, professional and fairly priced clinic. I took our French Bulldog as walk-in, right before closing and they were very helpful. Beni got his Benadryl and Antihistamine shots immediately. Thank You for the friendly staff, I will bring all my dogs here for shots and general visits as well.

The staff is very helpful, patient, and polite. The waiting room is a separate building next door and is useful if you don’t wanna sit in the car. Both dogs have had visits for different things and they have both had good experiences.
Thank you!!!

this establishment provided an overdose of medication to my 6 year old pomeranian back in 2024 and killed her. the vetererian Deborah Jackson was not even in the clinic performing services to my dog as we reasonably expected she would, and instead a young vet “Armendariz” was performing services on my pet without our knowledge or consent. Don’t go there!! I will still never forget this day nor the harassing, rude, and unsympathetic behavior from their office manager.

Wow what a horrible experience. I’m a new client and I show up at 8:38 on Monday and they have a Covid protocol still in place. I found it disconcerting and not very welcoming. I came in to get my dog treated for what I think is arthritic pain. His past Vet treated him with a cortisone shot. I came in asking for the same treatment. After 2 hours at 10:30 they call my cell to have the Vet speak to me while I’m in the parking lot. She refused to give him the shot, if she thinks it’s the wrong treatment that’s fine but she says that he has to go on expensive daily medication for life. Oh and we need to put him under and pull a tooth. When I pause and don’t immediately accept their diagnosis, their position is this is not the place to take my pet. Then Greg the owner comes out to speak with me in the parking lot. Again he takes the position that since I don’t seam to trust him this is not the place for me to take my pet. At this point I just need to get pain relief for my dog and I don’t want to find a new place to go at this point. The doctor continues with the same position if you don’t want to give us immediate trust we are not the place for you. How do you expect to establish any trust under these conditions. This place is a factory. In the 2.5 hours I was in the lot they saw lots of dogs so obviously there are people at there who will trust their beloved pets to someone they have never met. In the end I paid Greg $150 to get 2 weeks worth of pain meds. Just enough time to find a real Vet who will show care and concern and have an actual bedside manner.

We took our cat in because his eye suddenly got really swollen, and honestly, I’m so glad we chose this vet.

Everyone there was incredibly sweet and gentle with him, and they explained everything in a way that made us feel calm instead of stressed.

No pushing extra stuff, no weird upselling, just honest care.

The prices were totally reasonable too!

It really felt like they cared about helping our little guy get better, not about selling us things.

If you ever need a vet, I’d definitely recommend them. They made a scary situation feel so much easier.

PS: Cassandra is amazing!! She is extremely sweet and helpful 👍🏻  Also Ashley ~👍🏻

The best pet clinic by far. Amazing and caring staff. My little dude has always been in good hands under the care of Dr. Jackson and her staff. They all rock! Wouldn’t go anywhere else but at Warner Center Pet Clinic.

They were extremely gentle, friendly, and pretty quick for a walk-in clinic. Also, the vet is an angel and worked with me to be able to get the treatment Thank you my pup needed. I’m extremely grateful for their services and I highly recommend because they genuinely care.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Exceptional Care During a Serious Emergency

I cannot say enough wonderful things about the care my dog Callie received during a very serious and unexpected emergency. It was one of the most stressful moments of my life, yet Greg and the entire team provided a level of compassion, skill, and professionalism that is truly unmatched.

From the moment I called, Greg took the time to walk me through everything with incredible patience. Nothing was rushed. He explained every step of the process, what they were concerned about, and what they were doing to protect Callie’s health. His calm, detailed, and extremely knowledgeable guidance made a frightening situation feel manageable.

The staff treated Callie with extraordinary gentleness. You could see how carefully they handled her — every exam, every injection, every check was done with precision and genuine care. Their attention to detail was remarkable, and their communication was clear, consistent, and comforting throughout.

What stood out most was how thorough they were in both treatment and prevention. They monitored every risk factor, took proactive measures, and ensured Callie had the best possible chance to recover safely. After the procedure, they continued to give me all the time I needed on the phone, explaining aftercare, warning signs, and answering every question without ever making me feel rushed.

This team truly goes above and beyond. During a deeply emotional and overwhelming emergency, they showed expertise, compassion, and heart. Callie is healing beautifully because of their outstanding work.

Thank you to Greg and the entire staff — your care was truly exceptional.
I cannot recommend this clinic highly enough.

i’ve since gotten a new vet and its been many months but it would make me extremely uncomfortable to ignore the fact that this place LOVES when you’re too uneducated to know what to do about your dog’s health; they took hundreds of dollars from me and my grandma despite my dog not actually having anything wrong with him, and my final straw was when he started to bite himself and i came in to see what was making him do it (this was many months after him not having done so, and it was allergies that caused the issue prior… this time i was worried it was cancer, what his mother had, and that anxiety led to me inquiring on it) … i went in, asked to see if they could check him for anything cancerous (he had a lump on his tail, again i was worried) and asked if there was some sort of xray or something to be done, because i was worried and wanted to get to the bottom of the issue asap. they charged me 900ish dollars !!!! they went ahead, did bloodwork for shits n giggles, did an xray (then told me AFTER that it wouldn’t detect cancer?!), and sent me home more confused than i was before

ONE WEEK LATER A NEW VET TOLD ME HE HAD FLEAS THE ENTIRE TIME :) it was causing the new biting. they did useless bloodwork, took advantage of me asking about xrays, took advantage of my uneducated worries, and never noticed or didn’t care to notice that he had fleas… extra insane too since that endangers other dogs in the office if they don’t know when a dog has fleas?

anyways, this was a long overdue review and it wont accomplish much, but i’m here writing this because they duped me out of at LEAST 3 grand over the course of almost two years… over a 14yo dog who is perfectly healthy with some allergies here and there

I brought my dog here for a Rabies Vaccine Titer test needed for international travel. This experience was nothing short of frustrating and concerning. When I arrived, I CLEARLY explained to the nurse that my dog had ALREADY received his rabies vaccine, and we only needed the titer test and certificate for travel purposes. She quoted me $942.50 total, with an initial payment of $302.50 due that day and the remainder due when results arrived. I agreed to these terms. After waiting 30 minutes, they returned with an invoice for $336.50, the agreed $302.50 PLUS an additional $34 for a rabies vaccine. I specifically told them was unnecessary! When questioned, the nurse claimed "he needs it for the titer" which is completely false information. A titer test MEASURES EXISTING ANTIBODIES from previous vaccinations. Worse yet, administering multiple rabies vaccines within a short period could potentially harm my dog's health.They didn't give me any choice in the matter and I was forced to pay the full $336.50 to get my dog and paperwork. The nurse promised someone would contact me within 3-6 weeks after blood results arrived. It's now been ALMOST FOUR MONTHS with ZERO communication from them. No results, no follow-up, nothing despite taking a substantial deposit. This clinic appears to prioritize profit over pet health and owner concerns. They:
-Administered an unnecessary vaccination after being told my dog was already vaccinated
- Provided false medical information to justify additional charges
- Failed to communicate about test results for months
- Charged extremely high prices compared to other clinics

Save yourself the headache, money, and potential risk to your pet's health. These unprofessional practices make me question their integrity and competence as veterinary providers.

What makes this especially egregious is that pet care services should be built on trust and transparency. Our pets can't speak for themselves they depend on us to ensure they receive proper care. A veterinary clinic willing to administer unnecessary vaccines, provide false medical information, and neglect follow-up communication demonstrates a fundamental disregard for animal welfare and the human-animal bond. This type of behavior is particularly dangerous in pet healthcare where owners rely on professional expertise to make informed decisions. Unnecessary medical procedures can cause stress, potential adverse reactions, and health complications for our beloved pets. Any facility putting profit above pet health has no place in the veterinary profession. My advice? STAY AWAY from these professional scammers who clearly don't have your pet's best interests at heart!
